find_all_nearby_objects: find all connected block components near a position in the Minecraft world
find_closest_nearby_object: find the closest interesting object to a given position in the Minecraft world
find_connected_components: find all connected nonzero components in a 3D or 4D block array
check_entity_between: check if one entity is spatially between two other entities using convex hull
find_all_nearby_holes: find all holes and pits near a location in the Minecraft world
